pack_numpy_array_to_tensor_proto: pack a numpy array into a Tensor protobuf with optional zstd compression and chunking
unpack_tensor_proto_to_numpy_array: unpack a Tensor protobuf with optional chunks back into a numpy array
upcast_low_precision_floats_to_float32: upcast float16 or bfloat16 numpy arrays to float32 precision
test_pack_tensor_with_compression_and_ch: test packing numpy arrays of various dtypes with zstd compression and chunked serialization
test_round_trip_pack_unpack_tensor: test that packing and unpacking a tensor proto preserves the original numpy array exactly
